purpose: Targeted verification of sources already cited by TSA, not new federal benchmark research.

sources.title: Travel and Wait Times are Longest for Health Care Services
sources.assessment: Altarum analyzes ATUS 2006-2017 daily diaries. Its 34-minute travel summary is presented with time on a care day, not explicitly as one-way travel. Applying it to each leg requires clarification; do not impose a corrected value without replication of the underlying classification. The study covers broad health services, not applicant medical screening.

sources.title: Current and Maximum Acceptable Travel Times to Primary Care Among US Older Adults
sources.assessment: February 2025 survey analyzed 4,046 adults aged 50 or older. Current travel averaged 20 minutes; maximum acceptable travel averaged 53 minutes. FAMS uses the current value, not the willingness threshold. Age restriction and primary-care scope limit transfer to the applicant population.

limitation: Original PDF retrieved and hashed; primary article reviewed online. Source interpretation remains unresolved; these notes are analyst assessments, not verbatim source quotations.
